title: God Wants to Give You Everything
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a message of faith and prosperity, highlighting how God desires to bless His people with wealth and success, and how we can tap into this blessing by seeking His kingdom first. With real-life examples and prophetic words, Pastor Zehner will challenge and encourage you to pursue your business dreams and trust God for a miracle in your life. Join us as we explore the principles of financial prosperity and the promise of God's covenant in our lives.
